items.title: Ray Ricker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 27, 2022
items.q: But there were a lot of guys that recorded for Columbia like Miles Davis and Thelonious Monk, and that kind of thing. So I built a record collection that way.

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and it’s a privilege to be speaking with Doctor Ray Ricker this afternoon. Welcome.
Thanks, Monk. Glad to talk with you.

I had to practice this a little bit, that you are a classical and jazz performer, a music educator, a composer, arranger, and author, music contractor, and perhaps the quintessential example of a complete musician.
